about.frase: I am a professional in the field of Graphic Design and Production, with experience in various areas of the publishing and graphic arts sectors. Throughout my career, I have worked in production, project management, customer service, and process coordination, which has allowed me to develop a comprehensive and practical understanding of the industry. For several years, I was part of Copistería Soriano, where I held responsibilities related to graphic production management and the monitoring of publishing projects, learning to navigate dynamic environments with demanding work paces. Subsequently, I worked as a Product Manager at Luna Books, a period in which I was able to delve deeper into product development and the planning and coordination of publishing processes. My previous experience in technical and sales positions within the graphic arts has also helped me understand the sector from different perspectives and build a versatile and decisive profile. I am currently pursuing a Master's degree in Teacher Training and undertaking in-company training at the Barreira School of Art and Design, an experience that is bringing me closer to the field of education and allowing me to continue growing both professionally and personally. I consider myself an organized and dedicated person, eager to continue learning and contributing to the world of design, graphic production, and teaching.
